title.zh-CN: 高血糖难以控制与视力下降 · 21岁女性
title.en: Difficult glycaemic control and visual loss · woman aged 21

summary.zh-CN: 消瘦青年患者长期高血糖，常规治疗反应异常并出现视力变化，需要重新评估分型与用药安全。
summary.en: A lean young adult has longstanding hyperglycaemia, an unusual treatment response and visual deterioration; reconsider classification and medication safety.

provenance.citation: 杨国庆, 陆菊明, 肖建中, 韩学尧, 孙杰. 一例极度胰岛素抵抗综合征患者的临床和遗传学分析. 中华糖尿病杂志. 2011;03(01):81-84. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.1674-5809.2011.01.017.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 多饮多尿6年余，视力下降1年
chiefComplaint.en: Thirst and polyuria for over six years, visual loss for one year

triageNote.zh-CN: 因双眼视力进行性下降就诊，既往使用胰岛素及口服降糖药仍控制不佳。
triageNote.en: Progressive bilateral visual loss prompts admission; insulin and oral agents have not provided satisfactory glycaemic control.

name.zh-CN: 代谢、抗体与并发症评估

zh-CN: 代谢、抗体与并发症评估

text.zh-CN: 血糖控制不佳、低蛋白血症、大量蛋白尿及血脂异常；IAA、ICA、GADA均阴性。后续肾活检为糖尿病肾病，眼部检查示严重增殖性视网膜病变。
text.en: Poor glycaemic control, hypoalbuminaemia, heavy proteinuria and dyslipidaemia; IAA, ICA and GADA were negative. Subsequent renal biopsy showed diabetic nephropathy and ocular assessment severe proliferative retinopathy.

name.zh-CN: 监测与胰岛素反应记录

zh-CN: 监测与胰岛素反应记录

text.zh-CN: 逐渐增加胰岛素后日间血糖仍高，夜间却出现低血糖。停用胰岛素及口服药的观察期血糖未进一步明显升高。
text.en: Daytime glucose remained high despite escalating insulin, whereas nocturnal hypoglycaemia occurred. During observed withdrawal of insulin and oral agents glucose did not rise markedly further.

text.zh-CN: 胰岛素及受体抗体阴性，甲状腺、肾上腺功能及IGF-1概述正常；睾酮和LH/FSH升高，卵巢稍大。INSR测序有多个改变，外显子21终止改变被认为可能相关，功能意义仍需研究。
text.en: Insulin and receptor antibodies were negative; thyroid/adrenal function and IGF-1 were described as normal. Testosterone and LH/FSH were elevated with mildly enlarged ovaries. INSR sequencing found several changes; an exon 21 stop change was considered potentially relevant, with functional significance requiring investigation.

text.zh-CN: 报告最终归为A型胰岛素抵抗综合征，并列糖尿病肾病、增殖性视网膜病变、白内障、多囊卵巢、高血压及血脂异常；未给出可信的长期治疗结局。
text.en: The report classified type A insulin resistance with diabetic nephropathy, proliferative retinopathy, cataracts, polycystic ovaries, hypertension and dyslipidaemia; reliable long-term treatment outcome was not supplied.

guidance.en: Plan care and review the outcome

prompt.zh-CN: 消瘦、早发病和异常胰岛素反应应怎样影响分型？
prompt.en: How should leanness, early onset and an unusual insulin response affect classification?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 重新评估严重胰岛素抵抗及特殊类型糖尿病
text.en: Reassess severe insulin resistance and specific diabetes subtypes

feedback.zh-CN: 表型、家族线索和治疗反应不适合只沿用最初标签。
feedback.en: Phenotype, family clues and treatment response warrant revisiting the original label.

text.zh-CN: 仅凭高血糖认定患者从未用药
text.en: Conclude non-adherence from hyperglycaemia alone

feedback.zh-CN: 住院监测和日夜差异提示需检验生物学解释。
feedback.en: Observed inpatient treatment and day-night differences require biological assessment.

text.zh-CN: 年轻且曾有酮尿即可排除所有其他类型
text.en: Young age and earlier ketonuria exclude all other subtypes

feedback.zh-CN: 这些线索并不具有绝对分型特异性。
feedback.en: Neither feature has absolute subtype specificity.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 表型支持报告的A型抵抗判断，但测序改变的因果仍未完全证实
text.en: The phenotype supports the reported type A resistance assessment, but variant causality remains incompletely established

feedback.zh-CN: 候选序列变化与功能验证是不同层次的证据。
feedback.en: Candidate sequence findings and functional validation are different evidence levels.

text.zh-CN: 发现任何变异便证明唯一病因
text.en: Any detected variant proves the sole cause

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告明确提出需要功能研究。
feedback.en: The report explicitly called for functional work.

text.zh-CN: 卵巢改变足以解释全部极度抵抗和并发症
text.en: Ovarian changes alone explain all extreme resistance and complications

feedback.zh-CN: 高雄激素表现可为综合征的一部分，不应终止全身分型评估。
feedback.en: Hyperandrogenism can form part of a broader syndrome and should not end classification.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样处理高血糖与夜间低血糖并存的风险？
prompt.en: How should simultaneous hyperglycaemia and nocturnal hypoglycaemia be addressed?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 专科重新核对注射、时序和分型，关注夜间低血糖并个体化调整
text.en: Specialist review of administration, timing and classification, with attention to nocturnal hypoglycaemia and individual adjustment

feedback.zh-CN: 不能只按日间数值持续加量，需结合完整监测。
feedback.en: Dose escalation based only on daytime values ignores the full monitored pattern.

text.zh-CN: 照抄原报告极大输注剂量作为常规方案
text.en: Copy the report’s extreme infusion doses as routine care

feedback.zh-CN: 这是特殊历史试验经过，不能推广为可执行处方。
feedback.en: These historical exceptional interventions are not a transferable prescription.

text.zh-CN: 有夜间低值便永远停止所有糖尿病随访
text.en: Stop all diabetes follow-up permanently after nocturnal lows

feedback.zh-CN: 仍有高血糖和严重器官并发症需要专科管理。
feedback.en: Hyperglycaemia and serious organ complications still require specialist care.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明病程与治疗反应可促使重新分型。；承认规范化INSR变异命名、功能实验、完整HbA1c/肾功能数值及长期结局。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Course and treatment response can justify reclassification.; acknowledge Standardised INSR nomenclature, functional experiments, complete HbA1c/renal values and long-term outcome. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 早发、消瘦、高雄激素表型和严重胰岛素抵抗支持特殊类型糖尿病评估，候选INSR变异功能仍不确定。
conclusion.en: Early onset, leanness, hyperandrogenic features and severe resistance support evaluation of a specific diabetes subtype, while candidate INSR variant function remains uncertain.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病程与治疗反应可促使重新分型。
keyReasoning.en: Course and treatment response can justify reclassification.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 基因候选改变不等于已验证致病。
keyReasoning.en: A candidate genetic change is not validated pathogenicity.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 低血糖风险需要覆盖夜间。
keyReasoning.en: Hypoglycaemia assessment must cover the night.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 结合表型、家族史和抗体而非年龄单独分型。
teachingPoints.en: Classify using phenotype, family history and antibodies rather than age alone.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 对旧论文基因命名和功能解释保留边界。
teachingPoints.en: Retain uncertainty around historical variant naming and function.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不将极端历史剂量转成当前治疗推荐。
teachingPoints.en: Do not convert extreme historical doses into current treatment recommendations.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 规范化INSR变异命名、功能实验、完整HbA1c/肾功能数值及长期结局。
unknowns.en: Standardised INSR nomenclature, functional experiments, complete HbA1c/renal values and long-term outcome.
